the inclusive photon spectrum scales with energy, that the average π+ multiplicity is about a half of the average π0 multiplicty, and that the average η multiplicity is 0.64.
the average π+π− multiplicity exceeds the π0 multiplicity scaled by a factor of 0,5 and the measured photon production is in accord with the predictions of perturbative QCD.
